visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with shoulder-length brown hair, wearing a white short-sleeved crop top and black high-waisted leggings, sits cross-legged on a black pilates mat in a brightly lit studio. She gestures with her hands towards her chest while speaking directly to the camera. The background shows pilates equipment and large windows with greenery outside. (2) The scene transitions to the woman sitting on a pilates Cadillac machine. She holds a horizontal bar above her head with both hands. Transparent snowflake graphics drift across the screen. She maintains a calm facial expression. (3) The woman performs a back arching stretch on the Cadillac, holding the bar for support as her torso leans back towards the mat. Her body forms a bridge-like curve. The metal frame and springs of the equipment are clearly visible. (4) She returns to a kneeling position on a black box atop the Cadillac, looking at the camera and raising one finger as if making a point. (5) A side profile shot shows the woman kneeling on one leg while the other leg is extended straight back and up. She holds the overhead bar for stability. A white circle icon and a yellow checkmark graphic with text appear on the left side of the frame.
